pick.empty.all.cherry_pick.one: Nothing to cherry-pick: the branch already has the changes of {sha}.
pick.empty.all.cherry_pick.other: Nothing to cherry-pick: the branch already has the changes of all {count} commits.
pick.empty.all.revert.one: Nothing to revert: the changes of {sha} are already undone on this branch.
pick.empty.all.revert.other: Nothing to revert: the changes of all {count} commits are already undone on this branch.
pick.empty.left.cherry_pick: {sha} changes nothing: the branch already has its changes. Skipping it needs Git 2.23 or newer, so the cherry-pick is stopped there; Abort ends it.
pick.empty.left.revert: {sha} changes nothing: its changes are already undone on this branch. Skipping it needs Git 2.23 or newer, so the revert is stopped there; Abort ends it.
pick.empty.skipped_log: Skipped because they change nothing on this branch: {shas}
pick.empty.some.cherry_pick.one: Cherry-picked {done} of {total} commits; skipped {sha}, whose changes the branch already has.
pick.empty.some.cherry_pick.other: Cherry-picked {done} of {total} commits; skipped {count} whose changes the branch already has.
pick.empty.some.revert.one: Reverted {done} of {total} commits; skipped {sha}, whose changes are already undone on this branch.
pick.empty.some.revert.other: Reverted {done} of {total} commits; skipped {count} whose changes are already undone on this branch.
